sameToolBoundary: codex sandbox with generated trial profile; no model call

usageFixture.definition: Input includes cached input; output includes reasoning. Neither detail is added again.

usageCoverage: Deterministic stub events only; no provider requests

snapshot.readOnlyEnforcement: evaluate only under a profile granting read, never chmod alone

readOnlySnapshotProfile:
model = "gpt-6-astra"
model_reasoning_effort = "high"
approval_policy = "never"
default_permissions = "trial"
web_search = "disabled"
project_doc_max_bytes = 0
allow_login_shell = false
[features]
apps = false
multi_agent = false
remote_plugin = false
shell_snapshot = false
[plugins._default]
enabled = false
[permissions.trial.filesystem]
":minimal" = "read"
"/System/Library/OpenSSL" = "read"
"<probe>/final/source" = "read"
"<probe>/agent/materials" = "read"
"<probe>/agent/auxiliary" = "write"
"<probe>/agent/scratch" = "write"
"<probe>/agent/home" = "write"
"<probe>/bin" = "read"
"<probe>/final" = "read"
"<probe>/outside" = "deny"
"<probe>/control" = "deny"
"/Users" = "deny"
[permissions.trial.network]
enabled = false
[shell_environment_policy]
inherit = "none"
blockers: Detached descendants escape process-group shutdown; immutable final collection not guaranteed for hostile processes
Live CLI tool inventory, credential separation and inherited instruction exclusion not exercised without a model session
measurement: Probe/script stub only; no provider usage, no agent task
